rows.citation: Cohen, I., Yu, H., McDougal, R. A. (2026). All Models are Wrong, Some are Annotated: Automating Metadata in Biomedical Repositories. bioRxiv (openRxiv) preprint.
rows.model_type: ModelDB NEURON ion-channel/receptor mechanism source files (MOD files); LLM metadata classification
rows.controlled_mutations: no - existing ModelDB files are only classified; no edits, mutants or translations are generated.
rows.multiple_stimuli: no - baseline features come from one standardized three-step voltage-clamp protocol, not a battery of stimuli.
rows.electrophysiology_features: partial - XGBoost baseline uses summary statistics of simulated voltage-clamp traces (extrema, initial/final values, time-to-90% activation/recovery); not eFEL current-clamp features.
rows.protocol_optimization: no - single fixed protocol; no protocol selection or search.
rows.heldout_evaluation: yes - 253 of 1,100 annotated files held out for testing (stratified by subtype); held-out annotation labels, not held-out models for behavioural testing.
rows.ai_transformations: no - LLMs (GPT-5.2, GPT-mini) annotate mechanism labels from source code; they do not edit or transform models.
rows.distinction_from_neurosem: Uses simulation only as features for metadata classification of unmodified mechanisms. NeuroSem instead detects behavioural drift after transformations via mutants, calibrated tolerances and optimized current-clamp protocol batteries.
rows.verification_method: Crossref API (api.crossref.org/works/10.64898/2026.04.23.720371: title, authors, openRxiv posted-content, 2026-04-27); Europe PMC REST (PPR1213161, abstract); bioRxiv full text page (biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.04.23.720371v1.full) for methods and code link; GitHub API via gh (repo exists, created 2025-02-23, no license field).
rows.found_via: Europe PMC LLM AND (NeuroML OR Open Source Brain OR ModelDB); verified via Crossref + abstract

rows.citation: White, A. D., Hocky, G. M., Gandhi, H. A., et al. (2023). Assessment of chemistry knowledge in large language models that generate code. Digital Discovery, 2(2), 368-376.
rows.model_type: general chemistry / computational chemistry coding tasks (incl. MD analysis and simulation-method prompts); not neuron models
rows.controlled_mutations: no - no mutation of code or models; only prompt contexts (e.g. copyright header) and sampling temperature are varied.
rows.multiple_stimuli: no - not applicable; each prompt checked by its own unit tests, no stimulation protocols.
rows.electrophysiology_features: no - no electrophysiology; correctness judged by unit tests or expert evaluation of generated code.
rows.protocol_optimization: no - no test or protocol selection; partial analogue only in comparing prompt-engineering contexts.
rows.heldout_evaluation: no - benchmark of 84 author-written prompts across topics; no discovery/held-out split reported.
rows.ai_transformations: partial - LLMs (Codex davinci variants, CodeGen, InCoder) generate code from prompts; generation from scratch, not edits of existing models.
rows.software: nlcc https://github.com/whitead/nlcc ; data repo https://github.com/ur-whitelab/nlcc-data (cited, not separately checked); completions on Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6800475 (cited, not separately checked)
rows.distinction_from_neurosem: Benchmarks LLM code-writing correctness with unit tests in chemistry. NeuroSem targets behavioural preservation of edited neuron models using electrophysiology fingerprints, mutants and optimized held-out-evaluated protocol batteries; AI is only a possible case study.
rows.verification_method: Crossref API (api.crossref.org/works/10.1039/d2dd00087c: title, 11 authors, Digital Discovery 2(2) 368-376, 2023); Europe PMC REST (PMID 37065678, PMC10087057) abstract and fullTextXML for methods; OpenAlex (W4319996831) confirming venue/year; GitHub API via gh for whitead/nlcc (exists, no license field).
rows.found_via: Europe PMC LLM simulation code validation/benchmark query; verified via Crossref
